name: Summer In Trigue
source:
Sybil Harrison, struggling writer and connoisseur of dead-end jobs, at least believes she’s in a secure and happy relationship with Liz Fuentes, an ambitious but domineering young lawyer. Coming home early one day after being laid off yet again, she finds Liz in a compromising situation with another woman and her world falls apart.

Angry at being betrayed, she sabotages the romantic holiday she and Liz were about to embark on together to the romantic yet mysterious island of Trigue and goes on her own.
Once in Trigue, however, events quickly take a devastating turn and Sybil finds herself relying on four very different but captivating women to navigate her way through the mess she finds herself in.

But can any of them be truly trusted? And why hasn’t Liz even contacted her after that fateful day?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/617980/]Steam[/url]]
